record.rationale: INCLUDE: actual core contribution is MSD medical expert/layman style-transfer dataset derived from Merck manuals, physician parallel annotations, ICD-9/medical PCIO alignment and UMLS linking. Executed models and medical-concept ablations evaluate this corpus, not merely accessibility motivation.

Actual research is biological trade-off extraction for scientific reading and engineering biomimetics. Corpus includes JEB and BMC Biology/Evolutionary/Systems Biology. Dedicated biological extraction/cluster analysis is real, but its primary framing spans organism/evolution/ecology rather than established biomedical program. Immune/gene/liver-regeneration and bat-memory examples demonstrate biomedical-compatible content without establishing it as genuinely coprimary. Retain HOLD for biomedical-versus-broader-biology boundary, not disease requirement.

Biomedical relation extraction is substantive co-primary actual experimental arm, not bare benchmark mention: dedicated CDR/GDA evaluation, intra/inter-sentence error analysis, biomedical parser failure diagnosis and corresponding new LSR variant removing MDP nodes. General DocRED remains principal analysis elsewhere but does not negate this executed domain-specific design and analysis.

Clinical NLP is substantive coprimary actual design/data/analysis: MADE EHR entity calibration with BioBERT, EMRQA clinical QA, and a newly constructed MADE QA corpus using EMRQA templates for controlled clinical OOD transfer. Trains EMRQA language model for OOD perplexity feature, analyzes medical calibration and reranking; not healthcare motivation alone.

INCLUDE: main dataset is525 emergency medical service calls; clinical call question tracking with additional five-symptom sequence labeling is actually executed, medical call ASR trained on600 hours. Medical emergency workflow central, not incidental generic conversation benchmark.

INCLUDE: both language-pair experiments adapt MT to clinical/biomedical domain. Basque-Spanish uses actual hospital EHRs, clinical dictionaries and doctor-translated EHR templates; German-English uses medical-domain adaptation and Cochrane/NHS24 evaluation. Generic data selection is instantiated centrally for medical translation, not a token benchmark.

The actual contribution is unified generic flat/nested NER. Focused sections establish biomedical benchmark execution but not a substantive distinct biomedical research/design/analysis branch; no dataset-count rule used. Biomedical label queries are routine instantiation of the same generic framework, and explanatory experiments target general OntoNotes properties.

After independent reading of §4.1–4.6, biomedical use remains routine domain-appropriate pretrained input representation for a standard GENIA benchmark, not a genuinely co-primary biomedical research program. Explicit substitutions of frozen biomedical vectors, PubMed Flair and BioBERT are real and were not ignored, but the same generic Pyramid model/settings are intended across datasets; no biomedical-targeted redesign, custom biomedical data construction, dedicated biological mechanism analysis or domain-specific error investigation is established. Detailed layer/component explanations use ACE05 and the new overlapping-entity dataset is NNE. This differs from .141 specific parser-error-driven architecture variant, .188 purpose-built clinical OOD experiment, and .740 biomedical model training/transfer/data-selection program.

Unlike abstract-only reading, body shows explicit biomedical-domain diagnosis and multiple actual domain-conditioned representation choices. Whether these standard pretrained-model substitutions elevate GENIA from benchmark to genuine co-primary biomedical program is unresolved under the calibrated scope; retain HOLD for coordinator consistency comparison, not forced exclusion. This is not a dataset-majority judgment.

Biomedical sciences is motivating application only. Actual evaluated domains are Reuters AIDA-YAGO news, Women Writers Online literary history and 1641 Depositions historical legal testimony; user study reannotates 1641 corpus. No actual biomedical research arm.

Biomedical LM adaptation is substantive coprimary actual program: trains biomedical DAPT on2.68M full papers, analyzes domain vocabulary/loss, evaluates ChemProt protein-chemical relations and RCT sentence roles, directly studies RCT-to-ChemProt transfer, low-resource RCT and biomedical nearest-neighbor data selection. Not mere incidental benchmark because biomedical data construction/training and dedicated transfer/data-selection analyses instantiate central claims.
